form.label: Silk HQ — Meraki · Classic
form.description: Estado, seguridad, clientes y capacidad de la red Meraki. Simple XML: se versiona en robot-splunk-docs/dashboards/meraki-hq.xml

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:device | stats count by networkName | fields networkName

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:device networkName="$net$" | stats latest(status) as status by serial | stats count(eval(status="online")) as online count as total | eval v=online." de ".total | fields v

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:device networkName="$net$" | stats latest(status) as status by serial | where status!="online" | stats count as v | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval v=0 | fields v] | fields v

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:uplink networkName="$net$" | stats latest(status) as status by uplink | where status="active" | stats values(uplink) as v | eval v=mvjoin(v," + ") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval v="ninguno" | fields v]
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:uplink networkName="$net$" status=active | stats latest(latencyMs) as v | eval v=round(v,0)
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:uplink networkName="$net$" uplink=wan* | stats latest(lossPercent) as loss by uplink | stats max(loss) as v | eval v=round(v,2)
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:client networkName="$net$" | stats dc(mac) as v
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog | timechart span=1m count as c | stats avg(c) as v | eval v=round(v,0)

panel.title: Inventario — un renglón por equipo, último estado conocido

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:device networkName="$net$" | stats latest(status) as Estado latest(productType) as Tipo latest(model) as Modelo latest(lanIp) as "IP LAN" latest(publicIp) as "IP pública" latest(firmware) as Firmware latest(networkName) as Red latest(_time) as t by deviceName | eval "Último reporte"=strftime(t,"%d/%m %H:%M") | rename deviceName as Equipo | table Equipo Red Tipo Modelo Estado "IP LAN" "IP pública" Firmware "Último reporte" | sort Equipo
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:uplinkusage networkName="$net$" | eval mbps=(sentBytes+receivedBytes)*8/1000000/intervalSec | timechart span=5m avg(mbps) by uplink
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:uplink networkName="$net$" | timechart span=5m avg(latencyMs) as "Latencia (ms)" avg(lossPercent) as "Pérdida (%)"

html.div: Los paneles de abajo salen del syslog, que lo manda cada equipo directo al puerto 5515. Esos eventos no llevan el nombre de la red, así que el filtro "Red" de arriba no los afecta: se distinguen por equipo.

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog mk_type=flows | rex field=_raw "\sflows\s+(?<accion>\w+)\s" | eval accion=case(accion="allow","Permitidas",accion="deny","Bloqueadas",true(),accion) | timechart span=10m count by accion

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog (mk_type=flows OR mk_type=ip_flow_start) | eval Servicio=case(dport=443,"HTTPS",dport=80,"HTTP",dport=53,"DNS",dport=22,"SSH",dport=123,"NTP",dport=3389,"RDP",dport=5228,"Google push",dport=1720,"H.323 / video",dport=8088,"Splunk HEC",dport=8000,"Splunk UI",true(),"—") | stats count as Conexiones dc(src) as Clientes by dport protocol Servicio | rename dport as Puerto, protocol as Protocolo | sort - Conexiones | head 15

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog (mk_type=flows OR mk_type=ip_flow_start) | stats count as Conexiones dc(src) as Clientes values(protocol) as Protocolos by dst | eval Protocolos=mvjoin(Protocolos,", ") | rename dst as Destino | sort - Conexiones | head 15

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog mk_type=urls | rex field=_raw "request:\s+\S+\s+\w+://(?<Dominio>[^/\s:]+)" | where isnotnull(Dominio) | stats count as Pedidos dc(mac) as Dispositivos by Dominio | sort - Pedidos | head 20

panel.title: Reglas de firewall que más se aplican

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog (mk_type=firewall OR mk_type=vpn_firewall) | rex field=_raw "pattern:\s+(?<Regla>.+?)\s*$" | stats count as Eventos dc(src) as Origenes latest(_time) as t by mk_type Regla | eval "Último"=strftime(t,"%d/%m %H:%M") | rename mk_type as Tipo, Origenes as "Orígenes" | table Tipo Regla "Orígenes" Eventos "Último" | sort - Eventos | head 15
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog (mk_type=flows OR mk_type=ip_flow_start) | stats count as Conexiones dc(dst) as Destinos by src | rename src as Origen | sort - Conexiones | head 15
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:client networkName="$net$" connectionType=wireless | timechart span=30m dc(mac) by ssid
index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:wireless networkName="$net$" | timechart span=15m avg(utilizationTotal) by apName

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:client networkName="$net$" | stats dc(mac) as Clientes by recentDeviceName | where isnotnull(recentDeviceName) AND recentDeviceName!="" | rename recentDeviceName as AP | sort - Clientes

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:client networkName="$net$" | stats dc(mac) as Dispositivos by manufacturer | where isnotnull(manufacturer) AND manufacturer!="" | rename manufacturer as Fabricante | sort - Dispositivos | head 10

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:client networkName="$net$" | stats latest(usageSentKb) as up latest(usageRecvKb) as down latest(ip) as IP latest(ssid) as SSID latest(connectionType) as Tipo latest(manufacturer) as Fabricante latest(recentDeviceName) as AP by mac description | eval "Subida (MB)"=round(up/1024,1), "Bajada (MB)"=round(down/1024,1), "Total (MB)"=round((up+down)/1024,1) | rename description as Cliente, mac as MAC | table Cliente MAC IP SSID Tipo Fabricante AP "Subida (MB)" "Bajada (MB)" "Total (MB)" | sort - "Total (MB)" | head 20

panel.title: Tráfico promedio por hora del día (Mbps)

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:api:uplinkusage networkName="$net$" | eval mbps=(sentBytes+receivedBytes)*8/1000000/intervalSec | eval Hora=strftime(_time,"%H") | stats avg(mbps) as Mbps by Hora | eval Mbps=round(Mbps,2) | sort Hora

panel.title: Volumen de syslog por tipo — qué genera la red

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog | timechart span=10m count by mk_type

panel.title: Eventos de los equipos — asociaciones, autenticación, sistema

search.query: index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog mk_type=events | rex field=_raw "reason='(?<Motivo>[^']*)'" | fillnull value="—" Motivo | stats count as Eventos latest(_time) as t by mk_host type Motivo | eval "Último"=strftime(t,"%d/%m %H:%M:%S") | rename mk_host as Equipo, type as Evento | table Equipo Evento Motivo Eventos "Último" | sort - Eventos | head 20

index=meraki sourcetype=meraki:syslog | sort - _time | head 40 | eval Hora=strftime(_time,"%d/%m %H:%M:%S"), Detalle=substr(_raw,1,180) | rename mk_host as Equipo, mk_type as Tipo | table Hora Equipo Tipo Detalle
